title: Aura Hub V3
features:
Universal Aura (v2) — The Ultimate All-Game Utility Script
Universal Aura is a premium all-in-one utility script designed with a modern custom UI and smooth performance across all supported Roblox games.

🌟 Key Features

Aimbot (Hold Aim Key)
• Precision targeting with a configurable Aim Key
• Adjustable aim smoothness for human-like tracking
• Toggleable Head/Torso (HumanoidRootPart) targeting
• FOV Circle on/off + size slider
• Visibility Check to ignore players behind walls
• Ignore Teammates to prevent locking on friends

ESP (Visuals)
• Toggle Box, Tracer, Skeleton, Name, Distance, Health Bar, and Item ESP
• Built-in teammate filter
• Full RGB customization for Boxes, Tracers, and Text

General & UI
• Press RightControl to show/hide the UI
• Minimize button to shrink the UI to just the title bar
• Unload button to stop the script instantly
• Live FPS Counter in the title bar

⚠️ Loading Note
Sometimes the menu may appear up to three times on load. Close the extra two using the “X” button — the script will run normally.

⭐ Made by Benji
